entries.desc: Docs explain Lattice Host Overflow as host-neutral authority: Lattice owns story/scope/receipt/gate, Codex/Claude Code/Gemini are execution hosts.

evidence.note: README/guide/vision/nav and the new host-overflow decision doc describe the manual-first authority boundary and Claude Code execution-host role.

entries.desc: Docs explicitly say manual handoff comes before supervised dispatch and Claude Code unavailable is a diagnostic degradation, not a workflow blocker.

evidence.command: rg -n "manual-first|supervised dispatch|diagnostic degradation|not a workflow blocker" README.md docs/guide.md docs/requirements/decisions/host-overflow.md
evidence.note: Docs state manual-first handoff precedes supervised dispatch and unavailable Claude Code is reported as diagnostic degradation rather than a local workflow blocker.

entries.desc: Docs do not claim Lattice is a new agent runtime, Mac App requirement, productionDone source, or automatic trust/merge mechanism for Claude Code output.

evidence.command: rg -n "not a new agent runtime|Mac App is not required|productionDone=false|no auto-trust|no auto-merge" README.md docs/guide.md docs/requirements/decisions/host-overflow.md
evidence.note: Docs state Lattice Host Overflow is not a new runner, does not require Mac App, and does not claim productionDone, auto-trust, or auto-merge authority.

entries.desc: lattice host_status --host=claude-code --format=json reports overflow readiness, capabilities, limits, availability, and nextAction.

evidence.note: host-overflow smoke covers lattice host_status for claude-code/local-runner and proves overflowReady/status/nextAction stay diagnostic-only with productionDone=false and receiptVerified=false.

entries.desc: Unknown or unavailable host returns diagnostic unavailable/warn with nextAction and does not block local story workflow.

evidence.note: Host Overflow smoke covers unavailable and non-ready host diagnostics with nextAction while keeping the local story workflow unblocked.

entries.desc: Capability/status output keeps productionDone=false and receiptVerified=false; it never treats host availability as authority evidence.

evidence.note: Host Overflow smoke asserts host_status output stays diagnostic-only with productionDone=false and receiptVerified=false.

entries.desc: lattice handoff_create can create a Claude Code overflow pack with role, objective, baseSha, packId, packHash, allowedPaths, deniedPaths, requiredCommands, successCriteria, and authority boundary.

evidence.note: lattice-handoff smoke verifies bounded handoff packs include packId/packHash/baseSha-safe boundaries while preserving legacy handoff-pack-v0 compatibility and non-authoritative projections.

entries.desc: Existing handoff_create/inspect/accept/resume compatibility remains intact for old handoff-pack-v0 consumers.

evidence.note: Lattice handoff smoke preserves existing handoff_create, inspect, accept, and resume compatibility for handoff-pack-v0 consumers.

entries.desc: Handoff pack instructions forbid direct story JSON edits, auto-merge, auto-trust, evidence submission, receipt verification, and productionDone claims.

evidence.note: Host Overflow smoke verifies handoff pack instructions preserve authority boundaries and forbid direct story JSON edits, auto-merge, auto-trust, evidence submission, receipt verification, and productionDone claims.

entries.desc: lattice handoff_receipt_submit accepts a completed external-host receipt referencing packId/hash/base/head, commands, changedFiles, verdict, and limitations, then returns accepted-local status.

evidence.note: host-overflow smoke validates handoff_receipt_submit accepted-local and diagnostic flows, including pack-hash validation, scopeStatus, freshness, and the fixed authorityChanged=false / receiptVerified=false / productionDone=false boundary.

entries.desc: Receipt submit reports stale or scope warning/failure when head/base/hash or changedFiles do not match the pack constraints.

evidence.note: Host Overflow smoke covers stale head and pack hash mismatch plus changedFiles scope warning and failure diagnostics.

entries.desc: Receipt submit remains local diagnostic evidence with authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, and cannot satisfy server authority by itself.

evidence.note: Host Overflow smoke asserts handoff_receipt_submit remains accepted-local diagnostic evidence only with authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, and productionDone=false.

entries.desc: lattice handoff_worktree_create or equivalent projection returns worktree path, branch, baseSha, packId, allowedPaths, deniedPaths, and cleanup/merge guidance for an overflow task.

evidence.note: host-overflow smoke proves handoff_worktree_create returns isolated branch/worktree/cleanup guidance only, keeps external work unmerged, and warns when pack constraints are incomplete.

entries.desc: Worktree isolation guidance refuses or warns when pack constraints are missing and does not modify external host results.

evidence.note: Host Overflow smoke covers incomplete or unsafe pack constraints through warnings and keeps external host results untouched.

entries.desc: Worktree projection does not auto-merge, does not delete unaccepted work, and keeps external host edits outside the main Codex worktree until reviewed.

evidence.note: Host Overflow smoke asserts worktree projection returns guidance only and does not auto-merge, delete, or trust external host edits.

entries.desc: Host Overflow smoke passes and demonstrates host_status, handoff_create, handoff_receipt_submit, handoff_worktree_create, and host_dispatch JSON contracts.

evidence.note: Host Overflow smoke passed and demonstrates host_status, handoff_create, handoff_receipt_submit, handoff_worktree_create, and host_dispatch JSON contracts.

entries.desc: Smoke covers unavailable host, stale/hash mismatch, and out-of-scope changedFiles without blocking local workflow.

evidence.note: Host Overflow smoke covers unavailable/non-ready host behavior, pack hash mismatch, stale receipt freshness, and out-of-scope changedFiles without blocking local workflow.

entries.desc: Transcript and tests prove the flow works without Mac App and without claiming server receipt or production authority.

evidence.note: Transcript records the manual Claude Code overflow flow without Mac App and shows pack created -> receipt accepted-local -> scopeStatus=pass -> productionDone=false -> main-agent review/merge nextAction.

entries.desc: lattice host_dispatch --host=claude-code --pack=<pack> --mode=supervised --format=json returns planned dispatch metadata with nextAction and no authority changes.

evidence.note: host-overflow smoke verifies host_dispatch returns planned or unavailable with nextAction only, while preserving authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, and productionDone=false.

entries.desc: When Claude Code is unavailable, host_dispatch returns unavailable/warn plus nextAction instead of failing the local workflow.

evidence.note: Host Overflow smoke covers unavailable host_dispatch output with warning and nextAction instead of failing the local workflow.

entries.desc: host_dispatch never auto-trusts results, auto-merges diffs, submits evidence, verifies receipts, or claims productionDone.

evidence.note: Host Overflow smoke asserts host_dispatch never auto-trusts output, auto-merges diffs, submits evidence, verifies receipts, or claims productionDone.
